settings.heading: Live activity
settings.share_help: Your new discussions, replies and achievements can pop up for other members as they happen.
settings.mute_help: Stop showing other people's activity while you browse.

types.member: New members (once their email is confirmed)

sections.events_help: Each one is only shown to people who could see it anyway. Extensions you enable later add their own switches here.

admin.display_seconds_label: Seconds each event stays on screen
admin.max_toasts_help: How many toasts can stack up at the same time on a computer. Phones always show one at a time.
admin.mask_names_help: Shows names as "J…e" instead of "John Doe", and turns off the link to the member's profile. The full name never leaves your server.
admin.hide_composing_label: Hold events while the member is writing a post
admin.interval_help: Only while the tab is visible. With Flarum Realtime connected, public events arrive at once and this only fetches restricted ones.
admin.recent_on_load_label: Events from the last hour to show when a page opens
admin.recent_on_load_help: 0 starts from the moment the page opens; nothing older is ever replayed.
admin.keep_max_label: Keep at most this many events
admin.opt_in_help: When off, everyone's activity is shown unless they switch it off in their settings. When on, only members who switch it on are shown.
admin.exclude_groups_label: Never broadcast members of these groups
admin.exclude_tags_label: Never broadcast discussions in these tags
admin.purchase_show_buyer_label: Show the buyer's name on purchases
admin.purchase_show_buyer_help: When off, a purchase reads “Someone bought …”, with no name, avatar or link.
